plugin_desc: Yamaha RTX/NVR/FWX 路由器专用 SNMP 采集模板（企业号 1182，sysObjectID 前缀 1.3.6.1.4.1.1182.1 的 rtx/nvr/fwx/vRX/rt 产品叶）。除标准 IF-MIB 接口指标外，额外采集私有健康标量：5 秒 CPU 使用率（yrhCpuUtil5sec，直接 0-100%）、内存使用率（yrhMemoryUtil，直接 0-100%），以及按型号可选的 1/5 分钟 CPU、内存总量（yrhMemorySizeMB，MB）与机箱温度（yrhInboxTemperature）。不覆盖 swx/swr/swp 交换机。风扇/电源未暴露，故为 N/A。适用品牌型号——Yamaha RTX/NVR/FWX/vRX 路由器（如 RTX830/RTX1210/RTX1300/NVR700W/FWX120）。
name: Router

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Five-second CPU utilisation of the Yamaha RTX/NVR/FWX router (yrhCpuUtil5sec), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilisation of the Yamaha RTX/NVR/FWX router (yrhMemoryUtil), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total memory of the Yamaha RTX/NVR/FWX router (yrhMemorySizeMB, reported in MB and converted to bytes). Present only on models that expose this scalar.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Inbox temperature of the Yamaha RTX/NVR/FWX router in degrees Celsius (yrhInboxTemperature). Present only on models that expose this scalar.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
